title: Policy loans.
bodyText: An insurer may loan upon a life insurance policy, as collateral security, any sum not exceeding the cash surrender value of the policy.
bodyHtml: §431:6-314  Policy loans.  An insurer may loan upon a life insurance policy, as collateral security, any sum not exceeding the cash surrender value of the policy. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
